title: Semantic Layer Query Errors
dataSources: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs, Cube API request logs and pre-aggregation build metrics (`cube:api`), AtScale engine query logs, LookML validation and metric-definition change events.
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow and Cube query logs and APIs via HEC scripted inputs; AtScale engine logs; LookML content-validator output.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dbt:semantic_layer OR sourcetype=cube:api
| stats count as queries, sum(eval(status>=500 OR result="error")) as errors by metric_name
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/queries,1)
| where errors>0
| sort - error_rate
description: Tracks queries against the semantic/metrics layer and ranks metrics by error rate so a broken metric definition is caught before every consuming tool shows wrong or missing values.
value: The semantic layer is the single definition of each metric; an error there breaks the number consistently everywhere, so error monitoring is high-leverage.
implementation: Ingest semantic-layer/Cube query logs; schedule hourly; alert on error spikes per metric.
visualization: Table by error rate, timechart of query errors.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the shared definitions of your key numbers and flag when one breaks, so it does not go wrong everywhere at once.
